**능동 부저**는 안에 발진기가 있어 전원만 넣으면 정해진 음을 냅니다: An **active buzzer** has a built-in oscillator and plays a fixed tone as soon as it gets power. A **passive buzzer** vibrates at the frequency we feed it, like a speaker —
so PWM can change its pitch.
